==Chapters==
* Chapter 1: [[DPA06|Beauty Contest: The Pokémon Super Contest!!]]
* Chapter 2: [[DPA07|Dialga's Secret Keys]]
* Chapter 3: [[DPA08|Team Galactic's Conspiracy, Revealed!!]]
* Chapter 4: [[DPA09|Challenge! The Fortress Of Steel!!]]
* Chapter 5: [[DPA10|Serious Training on Iron Island!!]]

==Important events==
* Hareta and Mitsumi meet the Champion [[Cynthia]].
* Hareta meets [[Cyrus]] and has a battle, resulting in a loss.
* Hareta is trained by Byron.
* While training on Iron Island, Hareta meets [[Riley]] and receives a Pokémon Egg from him.

==Party changes==
*[[Mitsumi]] is revealed to have an {{p|Infernape}}.

===Additions===
The following Pokémon are obtained:
* Hareta's {{p|Zubat}} in [[DPA09]]
* Hareta's {{p|Geodude}} in [[DPA09]]
* Hareta's {{p|Riolu}} in [[DPA09]]

===Evolutions===
The following Pokémon evolve:
* Hareta's {{p|Shinx}} to {{p|Luxio}} in [[DPA09]]
* Jun's {{p|Staravia}} to {{p|Staraptor}} prior to [[DPA08]]

==Gym Battles==
Hareta defeats the following Gym Leaders:

* [[Maylene]] in [[DPA07]]
* [[Crasher Wake]] in [[DPA07]]
* [[Fantina]] in [[DPA07]]
* He also challenges [[Byron]] in [[DPA08]], but did not win the battle.

==Trivia==
[[File:Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure volume 2 dust cover.png|260px|thumb]]
* As the English volumes do not have dust covers like the Japanese ones, part two of the back cover gag is lost in the English release. The front cover image is moved to the end of the volume and changed into an explanation of the direction the book reads in.
===Errors===
* In the D・P Snapshots section, the sound effects next to {{p|Chimecho|Chirean}} and {{p|Chingling|Lisyan}} are part of their names. The English edition does not carry this over with Chimecho and Chingling, instead having "TING" and "CLANG".
